description: This file defines the SecurityHubClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS Security Hub service. It includes method annotations for the various API operations available through this client, and extends the generic AwsClient class.

classes.name: SecurityHubClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS SecurityHub service, providing methods to interact with the service's API.

methods.name: acceptAdministratorInvitation
methods.description: Accepts an administrator invitation to the Security Hub account.

methods.name: acceptInvitation
methods.description: Accepts an invitation to join a Security Hub master account.

methods.name: batchGetConfigurationPolicyAssociations
methods.description: Retrieves the details about the configuration policy associations.

methods.name: batchGetStandardsControlAssociations
methods.description: Retrieves the associations between standards and controls.

methods.name: batchUpdateStandardsControlAssociations
methods.description: Updates the associations between standards and controls.

methods.name: declineInvitations
methods.description: Declines invitations to join security groups.

methods.name: describeHub
methods.description: Provides details about a security hub.

methods.name: disableImportFindingsForProduct
methods.description: Disables findings import for a product.

methods.name: enableImportFindingsForProduct
methods.description: Enables findings import for a product.

methods.name: getAdministratorAccount
methods.description: Returns the account ID of the administrator account.

methods.name: getConfigurationPolicy
methods.description: Returns details about a configuration policy.

methods.name: getConfigurationPolicyAssociation
methods.description: Retrieves the details of a configuration policy association.

methods.name: getFindingAggregator
methods.description: Gets details about a findings aggregator.

methods.name: getFindingHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the history of a finding.

methods.name: getInsightResults
methods.description: Provides results for a specific insight.

methods.name: getInvitationsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of invitations for the account.

methods.name: getMasterAccount
methods.description: Returns details of the master account.

methods.name: getSecurityControlDefinition
methods.description: Gets details of a security control.

methods.name: listStandardsControlAssociations
methods.description: Lists associations between standards and controls.
